commit_message:
Split perf benchmarks into parallel jobs with serialized publish

- perf-divan: runs divan benchmarks, uploads artifact
- perf-gungraun: runs gungraun benchmarks, uploads artifact
- perf-publish: downloads both artifacts, generates index, pushes

The publish job uses global concurrency (group: perf-push) to prevent
race conditions when multiple workflow runs try to push to gh-pages.

Also switches from git config core.sshCommand to GIT_SSH_COMMAND env var
for more reliable SSH key inheritance in subprocesses.
